figures.caption_paraphrase: Panel (a) compares quaternary MSC and QD optical spectra; panel (c) shows a QD TEM image with a 50 nm scale bar. Panels (b,d) concern ZnSTe: the caption marks MSC spectra at 150 and 200 °C, while the plot legend labels the red spectrum 230 °C. The Results text describes a 150 °C MSC-349 context and 300 °C/30 min QD conversion.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
